daily.title: Trump sends envoys Witkoff and Kushner to Moscow and Kyiv with new plan to 'end the war'

Despite Trump's promises to resolve the conflict, Washington's efforts to broker a peace have so far come to nothing.

daily.summary: The UN General Assembly on Friday voted to shift away from the 16th-century Mercator map, designed by Flemish cartographer Gerardus Mercator, for a more accurate one reflecting the true size of continents. The resolution, spearheaded by several African countries and co-sponsored by France, was backed by 164 countries.
